dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Flathub container ready')"]
explanation: This configuration uses python:3.9-slim as the base image for a lightweight container. The requirements.txt contains the detected imports (github and publicsuffixlist) which will be installed via pip. The Dockerfile sets up the working directory, installs dependencies, copies the application code, and includes a simple placeholder command since the specific entry point wasn't specified in the task.
